rate_limits.correction: 600 requests per minute globally; Catalog endpoints additionally allow 100 requests per minute per integration, and product publishing allows 200 requests per 30 minutes. Error responses may not exceed 5% of total requests.

cors.correction: CORS is not supported; Printify requires API access through a server-side application.

description.correction: Printify API lets developers browse catalog data and manage merchant-shop products and orders, including creating and publishing products, submitting orders, calculating shipping costs, receiving webhook events, and supporting fulfillment workflows.

notes: V1 remains supported, although Printify recommends V2 for new integrations. The entry misses published rate limits, incorrectly leaves CORS unknown, and omits the mandatory User-Agent header. Its inventory-sync claim is not supported by the documented endpoints. OAuth 2.0 is also available for multi-merchant platforms.
